# mcp-audit
> Offline-first MCP server security scanner. Detects tool poisoning, hardcoded secrets, known-CVE servers, and rug-pulls. Aligned to the NSA May-2026 MCP security guidance and OWASP MCP Top 10.

## Landing page
- [mcp-audit](https://mcp-audit.dev/): Offline-first MCP server security scanner for AI agents. Inspects MCP servers across Claude, Cursor, and Desktop configs against 6 detection categories. Ships a git-committable rug-pull lockfile and a GitHub Action composite gate. One command, no cloud dependency, MIT license.
